title: The 1995 Hatton Garden Vault Break‑In: A Night of Silver

scenes.text: Eight seniors cracked a £14 million vault in one night?
The burglary happened at the Hatton Garden Safe Deposit Centre, London’s Diamond District.

scenes.query: open safe deposit box with empty space
scenes.text: Police recovered only £4 million of the stolen jewellery and cash.
The original CCTV still of the vault door after the break‑in.

scenes.label: ELUSIVE GANG
scenes.sub: Only two members were convicted; the rest vanished.

scenes.query: slow zoom on a safe lock

description: A group of elderly thieves used drills and a night‑time blackout to breach a high‑security vault. Their daring still sparks debate—follow for more vault stories.
